annotations.title: HTML or web page to PDF

description: Turn HTML you write (an invoice, report, letter or certificate) or a public web page into a print-quality PDF, rendered by Chrome with backgrounds and CSS. Use when you need to hand a person a polished, printable document. Send {html} or {url}; optional format (A4, Letter, A3, A5, Legal) and landscape. Returns the PDF. Errors: 400 missing input or private URL, 413 HTML over 2 MB. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

html.description: HTML to render. Provide html OR url.

url.description: Public page to print. Provide html OR url.

name: html_to_pdf
